author: StewieFG
body:
Hai :3
Here is another map i made :P
Name: Hexektus
Creators: EricV4
Description: A TDM  Map that has 20 vs 20 players, Red vs blue, No bows ( except from secret chest xD ), the map has good gameplay, detailed and fun :)
Helpers: izjust4fun ( make the map void ), alexanderjoe10 ( YML and server ) 
Stuff you start with:
Full lether armour ( each team color ), 64 Oak logs, 64 glass, Iron sword, Diamond pickaxe, 16 stakes, Nebula shop, 3 golden apples.
Pictures:http://imgur.com/a/hSu2c
Pictures with shaders: http://imgur.com/a/Djz7l
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/lisew5dwfkbalah/ericv42.rar
YML: http://pastebin.com/enYSvvbr
Thanks, leave feedbacks below :D

As for the YML:
Line 5: Keep it in lowercase. "tdm", not "TDM" please.
Line 7: EricV4 is not lined up with the creators: module.
Line 9: alexanderjoe10 is not lined up with the contributors: module.
Line 11: The map would last way too long. Make the time lower such as 1600.
Line 13: Indentation error. Pull "remove-drops" back.
Line 26: Indentation error. Align "damage resistance" with effects:.
Line 33: Spelling error. "Boats" should be "boots".
